text:
Market today: The mood is clearly nervous. Global bond yields are soaring to multi-decade highs, driven by renewed inflation fears and Middle East turmoil. This is a tough environment for growth-oriented tech and chip names, as higher rates make future earnings less valuable and increase borrowing costs.

Your holdings: SOXL is a major concern, down -55.68% and flagged SELL. SMH (-12.53%) and QQQI (-3.21%) are also flagged TRIM. Remember, margin amplifies these drawdowns significantly. SPAL is new, leveraged, and already down -36.82%.

Watch: Keep a very close eye on bond yields. Any further spikes will likely put more pressure on your concentrated tech book. Also, monitor your stops on SOXL, SMH, and QQQI.

Bottom line: The market is signaling caution; protect your capital, especially in leveraged and underperforming positions.
plays: SOXL: This leveraged ETF is down -55.68% and flagged SELL. Seriously consider reducing or exiting this position to protect capital, given its decay and the current market headwinds for chips.
SMH: Trim this position, respecting the stop at 540. Rising bond yields are a headwind for the chip sector.
No new buys today - hold and watch: The market sentiment is negative for tech/chips, and while the scanner has some long setups, the overall environment doesn't support initiating new long positions.
